description: Changes the user's UpFork profile: only what's given, the rest stays. A list given (skills, languages, social links, experience, pinned products) replaces that whole list, so read my_profile first and send the full list. A developer's profile is public: show the user the changes and save only when they agree. The photo, projects outside UpFork and the phone are changed on the site.

availability.description: "open" (open to work), "freelance", "busy", or "" to say nothing.

bio.description: About them, up to 2,000 characters ("" clears it).

clearYearsExperience.description: true to remove the years of experience.

contactEmail.description: An e-mail shown for contact ("" for none).

displayName.description: The name shown (a developer's products are sold under it).

experience.description: All their work and studies (replaces the list), up to 12.

items.description: A job or a course of studies.

end.description: When it ended, "2023-09"; leave out if it still goes on.

start.description: When it began, as a month: "2021-04".

headline.description: One line under the name, up to 100 characters.

languages.description: All the languages they speak (replaces the list), up to 8.

level.description: native, fluent, professional, conversational or basic.

location.description: Where they are, e.g. "Tehran, Iran" ("" clears it).

pinnedProducts.description: Up to 4 of their own products their page leads with, by slug, in order (replaces the list).

skills.description: All their skills (replaces the list), up to 30.

category.description: Its field: language, frontend, backend, mobile, data, cloud, ai, design, tools or other.

items.description: A link to one of the member's networks.

network.description: linkedin, x, telegram, instagram, youtube, stackoverflow, gitlab, dribbble, behance, devto, medium, virgool, codepen, leetcode, kaggle, huggingface, npm or bluesky.

url.description: The full address of the profile there.
